property_summary: For any caller address, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) on the correct contract only succeeds (does not revert) when msg.sender == owner; the mutant inverts this check so a non-owner can successfully call transferOwnership, which the property detects by fuzzing caller and newOwner.
change_summary: Changed onlyOwner to check caller is NOT the owner, inverting the access control so transferOwnership becomes callable by non-owners.
